title: 超越记忆：基于模板的异构协作知识工作与LLM智能体
summary: 本文提出llm-wiki-memory-template，一种可复用的、智能体感知的模板，通过LLM维护的互连维基解决知识工作中失败路径丢失和负面结果缺失问题。支持多人类、多AI智能体、多领域协作，三个案例研究验证其有效性。
summary_en: This paper presents llm-wiki-memory-template, a reusable agent-aware template that addresses failure-path loss and negative-result loss in knowledge work via an LLM-maintained interlinked wiki. It supports multi-human, multi-AI-agent, multi-domain collaboration, validated by three case studies.
